name: Step of the Wind
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Alternatively, you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the {@action Disengage|XPHB} and {@action Dash|XPHB} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.
